user.title: Domestic Intelligence Service
user.description: General settings. Announcements are not played during quiet hours (except the briefing after coming home).

data_description.ai_task_entity: Summarizes several missed notifications into one announcement. Without it, a simple list is read out.
data_description.tts_entity: Alexa Media speakers are announced directly; other speakers need a TTS engine.
data_description.home_entity: E.g. a house mode select or an 'anyone home' sensor. If set, it decides whether someone is home; persons then only define who gets push notifications.
data_description.ask_alexa: Lets Alexa ask yes/no questions in the room where someone is detected. Only works if the Alexa skill "Actionable Notifications" and its script are already set up in Home Assistant. Recommended for experts only – see the guide: {docs_url}
data_description.pet_mode: Motion in a return room only counts after an entry door was opened. Prevents pets or a robot vacuum from triggering the briefing before you are in the room.

persons.title: Persons
persons.description: Who should receive push notifications when at home?

data_description.persons: Person entities. For testing, an on/off helper also works (on = at home).

person_notify.title: Push for {person}
person_notify.description: Which notify service reaches {person}? Tip: a notify group covering all of their devices.

room.title: Room
room.description: Add a room with a speaker. Presence entities can be motion/occupancy sensors, but also lights, switches or media players: 'on', 'home' or 'playing' counts as someone being there. Rooms without presence entities always get announcements.

data_description.return_room: After coming home, missed notifications are delivered as soon as motion is detected in one of the return rooms, on that room's speaker.
data_description.hold_minutes: How long the room still counts as occupied after the last signal of its presence entities – for announcements and questions only, other automations are not affected. 0 = off: the room only counts as occupied while an entity is currently active (no extra cooldown). Handy for sensors whose cooldown cannot be adjusted. Note: this is added to the sensor's own cooldown (sensor 10 min + 5 min here = 15 min occupied) – it cannot shorten it. If the sensor's cooldown already fits, leave this at 0.
data_description.emergency_volume_step: Emergency notifications only: before the announcement the speaker is turned up by this many steps (Alexa scale 0–10, never above 10) and set back afterwards. Speakers differ a lot in loudness – e.g. a large speaker may already be very loud at 7, a small one still moderate at 10 – so set this per room. 0 = do not change the volume.

home_states.description: Which states of {entity} mean that someone is home?

ask_alexa.title: Alexa questions
ask_alexa.description: Select the script that starts an Alexa actionable notification (usually script.activate_alexa_actionable_notification). It must accept the variables text, event_id, alexa_device and suppress_confirmation. Guide: {docs_url}

pet_mode.description: After coming home, motion in a return room only counts once one of these doors was opened (or a lock unlocked). A door opened shortly before the arrival is detected also counts.

data_description.push_on_arrival: Without this, the push waits for motion in a return room, together with the announcement.
data_description.home_entity: E.g. a house mode select or an 'anyone home' sensor. If set, it decides whether someone is home; persons then only define who gets push notifications.
data_description.image_merge_seconds: Every notification with an image (e.g. doorbell) keeps its own snapshot. Only an identical one within this time is merged (the same person ringing twice).

data_description.max_pending: Notifications are only stored while nobody is home. Allowed: 1–100, default 20. Identical notifications take one slot and are counted ("3 times"). Notifications with an image take one slot each. When the store is full, the oldest notification is dropped.
data_description.high_priority_push: Applies to normal notifications. Emergency, urgent and low notifications always use their own priority.
data_description.emergency_repeat_minutes: Emergency notifications are repeated (push and announcement) until someone acknowledges them.
data_description.emergency_repeat_max: How often an emergency is repeated after the first alert (0 = no repetition). It ends earlier when someone presses "Seen" in the push, answers yes to the Alexa question, presses the "Acknowledge emergency" button or the notification is removed with presence_notify.clear.

send.name: Send
send.description: Push to everyone at home and announce on speakers in earshot. If nobody is home, the notification is stored. The priority changes this (see the field).

data.name: Data
data.description: Extra push data, e.g. image or actions.

speakers.name: Speakers
speakers.description: Only use these speakers (default: all configured).

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Emergency: always, on all channels, also at night and when nobody is home; all speakers, volume boost, repeated until acknowledged. Urgent: push to everyone right away, announcement (emphasized) only outside quiet hours. Normal: as before – stored when nobody is home. Low: push only and only when someone is home, otherwise dropped.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Optional ID for this notification, e.g. balcony_door. A new notification with the same tag replaces the old one, presence_notify.clear with this tag removes it from all phones and from the stored notifications.

store.name: Store when nobody is home (normal only)
store.description: Only applies to priority Normal. Off: when nobody is home the notification is dropped instead of stored, so it does not come with the briefing after coming home – for notifications that only matter at that moment (e.g. a dryer recommendation). Urgent, emergency and low notifications are never stored anyway.

remove_after.name: Remove automatically after
remove_after.description: Minutes after which the push is removed from all phones and the notification from the stored notifications (not part of the briefing anymore). Sending again with the same tag starts the time again. Without a tag, one is generated. Does not apply to emergencies.

push_to.name: Push to
push_to.description: Who gets the push. Empty = depending on the priority (urgent: everyone, normal/low: only the persons at home). All: everyone. Present: only the persons at home. Absent: only the persons away – e.g. doorbell: announcement for those at home, push for those away. With Absent and nobody home, a normal notification is pushed to everyone (and stored only if 'Store' is on). Does not apply to emergencies (always everyone).

recipients.name: Recipients
recipients.description: Only push to these persons (must be set up in the integration). Combined with 'Push to', e.g. only Dennis and only if he is away. Empty = all persons. Announcements are not affected (they depend on the rooms). Does not apply to emergencies.

announcement.name: Announcement text
announcement.description: Separate text for the speakers, e.g. short 'Someone rang the doorbell' while the push says more. Empty = 'Title: Message'. Not used for the briefing of stored notifications.

reminder.name: Send as reminder
reminder.description: The push gets the buttons "Done" and "Remind me later". Later: removed from all phones and sent again after the reminder interval – push and announcement, with a counter ("snoozed 2 times"); if nobody is home by then it is stored and comes with the briefing. Done (by anyone) or presence_notify.clear with the tag ends it. A reminder is always handled as priority normal.

remind_every.name: Remind again after
remind_every.description: Minutes until "Remind me later" sends the reminder again. Default: 60.

actions.name: Action buttons
actions.description: Buttons in the push. Without a link, pressing a button fires the event mobile_app_notification_action with the ID (generated from the title if empty, e.g. PN_OPEN_GARAGE). With a link, the button opens it.

deliver_pending.name: Deliver stored notifications
deliver_pending.description: Deliver all stored notifications now as one briefing.

speakers.name: Speakers
speakers.description: Announce on these speakers (default: speakers in earshot).

clear_pending.name: Clear stored notifications
clear_pending.description: Delete all stored notifications without delivering them.

clear.name: Remove notification
clear.description: Removes a notification sent with a tag: deletes the push on all phones, removes it from the stored notifications (so it is not part of the briefing) and ends an emergency with this tag. Example: balcony door closed again.

ask.name: Ask
ask.description: Ask everyone at home a yes/no question by push (with buttons) and, if enabled, by Alexa in the room where someone is detected. The first answer wins. Returns answer (yes/no/timeout) and by.

timeout.name: Answer time
timeout.description: Minutes to wait for an answer.

text_yes.name: Alexa reply to yes
text_yes.description: What Alexa says after a yes via Alexa.

text_no.name: Alexa reply to no
text_no.description: What Alexa says after a no via Alexa.
